title: Tidy after the settled-root read: a misplaced doc comment, an untested half of the history check, and a read twice in the recovery pass
outcome: The history check's comment and tests say what it does, and the recovery pass spends one read on a root it goes on to settle, as the recurring pass does.
acceptance: engram_learn_canonical_history has its ordering comment back directly above it.

A test shows a settled-root read whose read_cut or latest_event position is behind the acknowledged proof keeps withholding, and fails if engram_proof_keeps_acknowledged_history is taken out of the read-first check.

The recovery pass at a naming or turn opening hands an answered read to its batch, as the recurring pass does, so it spends one read per run, and the read's reader goes with it. The existing tests hold.
